name: Plan Earned Media Outreach
summary: Plan evidence-led earned-media outreach around genuine news value and respectful journalist relevance.
description: Plan a press narrative, media list, briefing materials, or journalist outreach around verifiable news value, relevance, timing, and source readiness. Use when an authorized organization seeks earned coverage rather than paid placement or indiscriminate pitching.
risk_reason: This skill plans evidence-led earned-media outreach around genuine news value and respectful journalist relevance; it does not promise coverage or pressure editorial independence.
refuses: It does not fabricate news, sources, quotes, exclusivity, urgency, or prior relationships.
It does not scrape private contacts, spam broad lists, harass after decline, or disguise paid placement.
It does not promise coverage or pressure editorial independence.

operational.latency_reason: The skill plans evidence-led earned-media outreach around genuine news value and respectful journalist relevance, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
